method.purpose: Q-429 remedy: every Group A cell re-solved with the v1.0.39 60-digit control; the stored witness and its nominal truncation are scored separately against the cell target
method.horner: both routes, fused (math.fma) and separate; the worse error is reported
method.score_note: the tagged control scores the relative error; for the abs:5e-14 cells the wrapper scores the absolute error, matching the corrected record's own acceptance
method.control_walk: reproduce the record pair; walk downward with a full sweep of every admissible pair at each count (default route, tightened only if the default route found no meeting fit), stopping at the first count where neither route meets; accepted = meeting fit with smallest e60; 4001 check on the accepted fit
method.supplement_note: cells whose record delivered_2001 did not reproduce have no control count60 ladder; for those the level at the recorded nominal count was swept by analysis/supplement_count60.py with the same scoring and routes, recorded in summary.supplementary_count60_sweeps and marked count60_level.supplement=true; the raw cell files are unchanged
